dishes.songTitle: Every Time the Sun Comes Up
stanza: People say I'm a one hit wonder
But what happens when I have two
But I shit in your bathroom

fishes.line: I wanted to go out like you, swim with the fishes
stanza: When I was fifteen, naked, next-door neighbors did a drive-by
Pulled me up by my waist, long hair to the beach side
I wanted to go out like you, swim with the fishes
That he caught on Rhode Island beaches
But, sometimes, it's just not your time

fishes.songTitle: My Bucket’s Got a Hole in It
fishes.line: I seen the crabs and the fishes
stanza: Well, I went up on the mountain
I looked down in the sea
I seen the crabs and the fishes
I get eaten by the worms
